about: Cases where roc-font deliberately or knowingly differs from its recorded oracle result. scripts/conformance.py fails on any unlisted difference and on any listed case that now agrees; it never edits this file. Keep entries sorted by id; every entry needs a reason a reader can act on.

entries.reason: avar version 2 is out of scope for 0.1.0: roc-font drops the font's variation space (`Font.axes` is empty, so the driver answers `coords:`), where HarfBuzz applies avar2 and reports the normalised coordinates.
OTS rejects the font because it has no `OS/2` table. roc-font treats `OS/2` as optional (architecture §4.4), so accepting the font is deliberate.
OTS rejects the subset because it has no `name` table. roc-font does not require `name`, so accepting the font is deliberate.

HarfBuzz applies Apple-style `kern` tables (version 1.0, formats 0 and 2) and splits each value into an advance and an offset; roc-font reads only the OpenType version 0 `kern` table and returns no offsets yet (architecture §6.2, `kern` values split as HarfBuzz does).

OTS discards an Apple-style `kern` table (version 1.0: 'Unsupported table version: 1'); roc-font ignores that version without reporting it, so it accepts the font. Lenient reading with `Font.dropped` (architecture §4.4) should report the table as dropped.
